Welcome to Massage Therapeutics! My name is Maria Natera, and I’ve been a licensed massage therapist for over 35 years. During my career, I’ve given more than 25,000 massages, gaining invaluable experience along the way. While I’ve scaled back my private practice, my passion for massage remains strong, and I’m now focused on teaching and sharing my knowledge.

Massage therapy has given me the honor of helping people heal and thrive. Now, it’s my turn to give back. Through these videos, I hope to inspire and empower anyone interested in massage—whether you’re a student, therapist, or simply curious.

Thank you for watching, learning, and joining me on this journey. Now go out and create a great day!
